picks.editorial_note: UW is leading or supporting four projects under DOE's new Genesis Mission, a 300+ institution national initiative to accelerate scientific discovery with AI — signaling a major federal bet on AI-for-science research infrastructure.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE Genesis Mission award tasks Brookhaven and Stony Brook with building a next-generation AI foundation model for the U.S. electric grid, a concrete application with national infrastructure stakes.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for DOE's 'Mine of the Future' initiative shows AI research expanding into critical minerals and industrial modernization, a growing federal priority.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million naming gift establishing a new AI college at UNT reflects continued heavy private investment in dedicated AI academic infrastructure.
picks.title: UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics

picks.editorial_note: Notre Dame's $10M OpenAI Foundation grant to bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers is a rare example of AI research with immediate, large-scale humanitarian impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's rollout of ChatGPT Edu to over 80,000 students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, illustrating how quickly industry-academia AI partnerships are scaling.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: USF's unveiling of its new Bellini College of AI, Cybersecurity and Computing building, backed by a $40 million gift, marks continued institutional commitment to building dedicated AI education infrastructure.
picks.title: USF President Limayem announces location, unveils plans for new Bellini College building

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory technology achieves a 100x improvement in storing continuous values rather than binary states, a hardware advance that could meaningfully improve efficiency for AI-capable smart devices.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's InstructMesh, developed with Google and Northeastern, lets users repair and fabricate AI-generated 3D models accurately, addressing a real usability gap in generative 3D design tools.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: An Australia-first pilot with CSIRO, ResetData, and the University of Queensland to make AI data-center GPU loads dynamically grid-aware tackles a pressing problem: AI's rapidly growing energy footprint.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets
